title: write_signing_key bool param should be enum
description: signing.rs: write_signing_key takes a bool parameter named 'force'. Bool parameters that control behavior create call-site confusion: write_signing_key(&key, &path, true) is opaque. Idiomatic Rust uses a small enum (e.g. enum Overwrite { Force, NoOverwrite }) so call sites self-document. This is especially important for a security-sensitive operation (overwriting a signing key) where a misreading of the bool could silently overwrite a production key.
